purpose: Define the memory ledger passed to the LLM and the deterministic loop checks used before any future gated live-action integration.
verifier_checks: repeated same action_id and slots without new buyer info
asking for use case after use case already known
asking for team after buyer said not team
recommending same plan again without new context
not changing explanation after buyer says they do not understand
no raw URL speech unless explicitly allowed
replan_triggers: repeated same action_id and slots without new buyer info
asking for use case after use case already known
asking for team after buyer said not team
recommending same plan again without new context
not changing explanation after buyer says they do not understand
raw URL speech when a safer reference is available
hard_fallback_triggers: fake side-effect claim remains after replan
unsupported factual claim remains after replan
safety-critical boundary violation remains after replan
output cannot be parsed or validated after one replan
replan_instruction_examples: The last response already asked this. Use the known answer and move forward.
Buyer corrected you. Preserve the correction and do not repeat the wrong wording.
Buyer said they already told you. Summarize known context and move to the next useful step.
Buyer seems confused. Explain differently, not louder or longer.
